info.title: onboard API
info.summary: Config-as-data control plane: client descriptor in, onboarding artifacts out (ADR-0045 P1, ADR-0058).
info.description:
Turns one client descriptor (the CS-Admin source of truth) into the downstream onboarding artifacts, and previews a descriptor's derive/expression rules against sample tags. Generation uses the exact code path of the `onboard-gen` CLI, so both produce byte-identical artifacts.

Served on its own plaintext listener (ONBOARD_API_PORT, default 9105) only when ONBOARD_API_ENABLED=true and ONBOARD_API_KEY is set (the process refuses to start when enabled without a key). Two binaries mount it: the cloud `sparkplug-decoder` container (edge-transformer binary) — the instance edge-api calls via ONBOARD_GENERATE_URL — and, optionally, `sparkplug-agent` on edge boxes (not enabled on the staging agents).

Public exposure: none. No nginx vhost routes to port 9105 on staging or production. In production `sparkplug-decoder` is behind the `client-ingest` compose profile, so it runs only when that profile is enabled.

servers.description: In-network on packiot-net (alias edge-transformer). Static IP 172.18.0.23:9105 on staging and production.

post.summary: Generate onboarding artifacts from a client descriptor
post.description: The body is the descriptor itself, as YAML or JSON (JSON is parsed as YAML). Artifacts are always generated in draft/observe mode; cutover readiness is reported in `validation` instead of blocking generation. Body cap ONBOARD_API_MAX_BODY_BYTES (default 4 MiB) on the agent; the cloud instance uses the 4 MiB default.

500.description: `generation failed: ...` or `validation failed: ...` — an internal generator fault for a descriptor that passed validation.

post.summary: Run a descriptor's derive/expression rules against sample input tags
post.description: Builds the tenant profile from `descriptor` and feeds `samples` in order through the same derive core the `derive-replay` CLI uses; each sample is processed as its own one-tag envelope. Returns the active rules and every synthesized tag. All samples are treated as good quality.

bearerKey.description: `Authorization: Bearer <ONBOARD_API_KEY>` — a shared static key (not a JWT), compared in constant time. Scheme is case-insensitive.

BadRequest.description: `payload too large`, `cannot read body`, `empty body`, `invalid JSON body: ...` / `missing descriptor` (simulate), or the descriptor's parse/validation/authoring error message.

ClientDescriptor.description: Client descriptor (services/sparkplug-decoder/internal/agent/clientdescriptor). Large and evolving, so only the top-level keys are listed; the authoritative shape and validation rules are in clientdescriptor.go.

tenant.description: SparkPlug group_id / enterprise short name, e.g. `CPACK`.

mapping.description: Raw -> canonical quirk absorber, copied into the tenant profile.

plc.description: Optional PLC connectivity + tag map; enables `client_yaml` and `reader_flow`.

artifacts.description: Artifacts as strings, to be stored/applied verbatim.

register_sql.description: SQL that registers the generated equipment topics (topic-routing table).

client_yaml.description: PLC reader client.yaml; present only when the descriptor has a `plc` block.

reader_flow.description: Node-RED PLC-reader flow including authored customizations; present only when the descriptor has a `plc` block.

inferred_count_indices.description: Count indices not yet confirmed on a live tee.

cutover_eligible.description: false when any count index is inferred.

unmapped.description: Descriptor topics that synthesize no canonical metric.

descriptor.description: The client descriptor as a JSON object. (The handler comment mentions a YAML string, but the raw value is parsed as YAML into the descriptor struct, so a JSON string is rejected with 400.)

after_input.description: Input metric whose arrival produced this tag.
